capabilities: Create new D2 files from the command palette
Edit D2 source with automatic re-render after edits pause
Render diagrams to SVG locally via a bundled WebAssembly engine
Resolve relative D2 imports between vault files
Reuse and refresh the SVG preview after each successful render
disambiguation: Not a general file previewer; it only handles .d2 diagram sources and their SVG output.
extras: iOS/iPadOS support is installed but unverified on a physical device; large vaults with many D2 files may render slower because all vault D2 files are supplied to the renderer for import resolution. Version 1.0.x used a system D2 executable, which is no longer required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to edit D2 diagram files or produce rendered SVG output from them.

relations.evidence: Rendering runs locally and offline through the bundled D2.js/WebAssembly engine.

summary: Editor for D2 diagram source files that renders sibling SVG previews locally after each edit.
